clue.text: Find a wife in one African country or another

explanation.definitionFit: A cache is a hidden store one can draw on secretly.

clue.text: Delighted, possibly having ended on the rocks, welcoming rescue craft

clue.text: Idle dogs resolved to knock off

explanation.walkthrough: 'Knock off' wants to mean stop work, matching idle dogs; here it means to dislodge, knocking something from its place.
explanation.definitionFit: To dislodge something is to force it loose from its position.

to pare wood away with a knife, cut by cut
